title: KOD HUB AIMBOT
features:
🔥 KOD HUB | AIMBOT – Advanced Universal Script 🔥

✅ Aimbot – Locks onto Head, Torso, HumanoidRootPart, LeftLeg, RightLeg (cycle with one click).
✅ FOV Slider – Adjust detection radius (10–610) with a live bar.
✅ FOV Circle – Toggle a visible circle showing your aim range.
✅ ESP – Boxes + lines around enemies, with Team Check (ignore allies) and Health Bars (dynamic color).
✅ Kill Check – Only targets alive players.
✅ Wall Check – Raycast detection, ignores targets behind walls.
✅ Rainbow UI – Animated borders and elements (red ↔ blue).
✅ Floating Minimize Button – Customizable icon to hide/show menu.
✅ Copy Discord – One‑click copy invite link to clipboard.
✅ Startup Popup – Shows TikTok and Discord info.
✅ Lightweight & Draggable – Fully customizable interface.

📱 TikTok: @bensonulysess1
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/nU9MNnByHH

changelog.message: First release – KOD HUB AIMBOT with ESP, Health Bars, FOV, Rainbow UI, and Discord/TikTok credits.
